section.description: Echoed back from the input packet. apply_synthesize checks it against the task's own inputs, so a synthesizer answering for the wrong section cannot overwrite another section's file.

body.description: LaTeX prose for this section, and nothing else: no \section heading (render emits that from the validated title), no preamble, no \begin{document}. The only commands permitted are \cite{} and \factref{}; gate 5 checks the keys and latex.escape neutralises everything else. minLength counts characters including whitespace, so the pattern re-checks 40 characters of actual content — 200 spaces passes the first and fails the second.
